Wallet: native wallet “awdaw”; password `qwerty123`. Dev server: `localhost:3000` or `$PORTLESS_URL` with Portless.

ShapeShift aggregation supports pair-dependent same-chain swaps and cross-chain bridges; USDC spans 13+ chains. Relay and NEAR Intents support some of both; Chainflip is cross-chain only (observed ETH→USDC minimum 0.0039 ETH); CoW Swap is same-chain only, with MEV protection and often low gas. 0x, Jupiter, Portals, and others vary by pair/chain; Jupiter and Cetus are Solana-specific, Sun.io Tron-specific.

UI shows available quotes and collapsible unavailable swappers (hover error icons for details). Relay may say “Amount too low”; Chainflip may show a minimum. Quotes show output, delta, USD gas, time, price impact, badges; default sort Best Rate. Loading: “Fetching quotes for this pair, this can take up to 15 seconds.” Skeletons appear while loading. Receive address editable; cross-chain destination may warn (e.g., SOL needed on Solana). Trade Settings untested. Switch Assets reverses pair. Click asset title text to select; clicks near icons/addresses may copy address. Multi-chain assets expand to show chains, ticker, balance.
